metadataRaw.title: The Inner Thigh Pain Muscle (How to Release It for INSTANT Relief)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over the main muscles associated with inner thigh pain and discomfort: the adductors. 

When these muscles become weak and tight, they can become strained, leading to pain in the groin and inner thigh.

To fix this, we'll go over easy exercises that help release muscle tension while strengthening the adductors for both quick and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently and is performed in a different position. For the best results, go through them all and use the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and fix your inner thigh pain!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:51 Lying Butterfly
2:36 Seated Butterfly
4:10 Frog Rock Backs
5:44 Wall V-Stretch
7:26 Strengthening Exercise
